definitions.explanation: Related to environmental conservation or products that are good for the environment.

examples.japanese: エコ⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がけている→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: I try to live an eco-friendly lifestyle.

examples.japanese: ⟦エコバッグ→エコバッグ：08937_ekobaggu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持参|じさん}→持参：00127_jisan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I bring my own eco bag.

examples.japanese: ⟦エコカー→エコカー：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}えた→乗り換える：01194_norikaeru⟧。
examples.english: I switched to an eco-friendly car.

notes:
エコ is short for ⟦エコロジー→エコロジー：noentry⟧ (ecology). It functions as a prefix meaning "eco-friendly" and is extremely common in modern Japanese marketing and daily life.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦エコバッグ→エコバッグ：08937_ekobaggu⟧: reusable shopping bag (very common since Japan's plastic bag charge in 2020)
- ⟦エコカー→エコカー：noentry⟧: eco-friendly car (hybrid/electric)
- エコ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: eco activities, green initiatives
- エコ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: eco-friendly products
- ⟦エコポイント→エコポイント：noentry⟧: eco points (government incentive program)

COMMON PATTERNS:
Can be used as a na-adjective modifier: エコ⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (eco-friendly lifestyle), エコ⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧ (eco-friendly choice).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やさしい→易しい／優しい：00475_yasashii⟧: environmentally friendly (more formal)
- ⟦グリーン→グリーン：noentry⟧: green (as in green energy, green initiatives)
- ⟦サステナブル→サステナブル：06154_sasutenaburu⟧: sustainable
